research_question: Does the frozen small SIFT model generalize beyond the two successful frontend families when the held-out shift changes mechanism, composition, runtime semantics, state dependence, or observation quality?
scientific_rule: More rows from the same generator do not count as stronger generalization evidence; every evaluation stratum must hold out a complete mechanism or composition family.

stages.description: Evaluate the frozen loop-08 checkpoint without adding training examples, learned parameters, or target-family demonstrations.
If stage A exposes a mechanism gap, train only detached primitive families; keep all composed vulnerability families fully held out.

decision_policy.stage_A: Treat the result as a diagnostic map, not a pass/fail claim. Classify each failure by representation, memory binding, composition, state, or evaluation.
decision_policy.stage_B: Proceed to three-seed confirmation only if primitive-only adaptation improves at least one failed axis by 10 percentage points without target-family leakage or old-family regression over 2 points.
decision_policy.scaling: Do not increase model size or bulk data until the mechanism-level ablation identifies a capacity bottleneck.
